description:

description:
Briolette ([https://github.com/Briolette](https://github.com/Briolette)) is an opinionated digital currency framework that provides a foundation for digital currency designers, whether centralized or decentralized. Join this meetup to learn more about the Briolette lab, its core design and the associated tradeoffs, and how to get involved!

title: From Identity-First to Authority Continuity
description:
We built security around identity, tokens, and roles. It was never quite right, capability theorists knew this decades ago. AI agents just made the cracks impossible to ignore.

This is the moment to correct the model.

title: 🧉 Mate Talk | Latency vs. AI: The new Trade-off in Live Streaming
description:
🧉 **Mate Talk is coming!**

**Latency vs. AI: The New Trade-Off in Live Streaming**
For the last five years, live streaming has been in a latency arms race — sub-three seconds, sub-one second, glass-to-glass parity with broadcast. We've spent real engineering capital getting there.

Now AI is showing up in the same pipeline: live translation, real-time dubbing, AI-generated sign language, multilingual captioning. Each one adds processing time, buffer requirements, and packaging complexity.

The two priorities are pulling against each other, and the industry hasn't fully admitted it.

In this Mate Talk we'll dig into what that trade-off actually looks like in production.

Join us with **David Hassoun, Olga Kornienko, Bhavesh Upadhyaya, Sean McCarthy, Andy Beach, and our special guest Neal Roberts.**

Mark your calendar and bring your energy.
**See you soon! 💚**

* ¿Quién debería decidir?
* ¿Cómo distribuimos responsabilidades?
* ¿Cómo fomentamos la participación sin volvernos burocráticos?
* ¿Cómo avanzamos sin quedar atrapados en reuniones interminables?

En este encuentro de AgileUY vamos a explorar una propuesta que busca abordar estos desafíos: **la Sociocracia**.

La Sociocracia es un modelo de gobernanza que propone nuevas formas de organizarse, distribuir autoridad y tomar decisiones de manera más participativa y efectiva.

title: Increasing Trust on Ethereum with ENS and Enscribe
description:
Most organizations on Ethereum are effectively anonymous. Contracts are deployed to nameless addresses, treasury wallets have no verifiable link to the org that controls them, and AI agents operate with no on-chain accountability. For protocols and DAOs trying to build credibility and operate transparently, this is a real problem — and it's one that existing tooling hasn't solved.

In this webinar, we'll walk through how organizations can easily create and manage on-chain identity for everything they deploy, using ENS as the identity layer supported by Enscribe ([https://www.enscribe.xyz/](https://www.enscribe.xyz/)). We'll show how protocols can name and manage their smart contracts, wallets, and agents under a unified namespace, making their on-chain presence verifiable, human-readable, and auditable.

description:
Open source is the foundation of Web3, but most ecosystems still fund it like a series of short-term projects instead of long-term public infrastructure. As decentralized networks grow, the real challenge is no longer just building software. It is maintaining the critical code, tooling, standards, and contributor communities that keep the ecosystem secure, usable, and resilient.

We will examine why traditional grant models often fall short, how maintenance differs from feature delivery, and why decentralized ecosystems need clearer coordination structures without recreating centralized control. title: Policy-Checked, Attributable, Revocable, Provable AI Agent Authorization
description:

Autonomous agents need identities they can prove, credentials others can verify, and a way to pay each other for the things they consume. That is our home turf.
